findings.requirement: E1/D2 source scope includes SVG and all computed UI text
findings.currentExpectation: The scanner API test expects extensions to equal .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs and .css, omitting .svg.
findings.requiredExpectation: SVG files and SVG text attributes must be scanned; sub-12px SVG text must produce a typography floor finding rather than be skipped or return clean.

findings.requirement: E1/D3 permit application colors only through registered tokens or exact registered exceptions
findings.currentExpectation: The raw-color table explicitly expects `a { color: var(--unregistered-local) }` to return no finding.
findings.requiredExpectation: A color-valued unregistered custom property reference must produce an unregistered-color-token finding. Registered color token references remain clean.

findings.requirement: D9 rejects arbitrary family, size, weight, line-height and letter-spacing values
findings.currentExpectation: A permitted-case test states that weight, tracking and leading are outside this lane, while no other named scanner owns D9 typography properties.
findings.requiredExpectation: Named registered utilities or tokens may pass, but arbitrary or literal off-role weight, line-height and letter-spacing values must fail.

findings.requiredExpectation: A paint color embedded in a CSS data-URI must be parsed and reported or must fail closed as unsupported. Only an exact centrally registered asset or exception boundary may pass.

findings.requirement: E1 must not silently lose governed values through AST indirection or builders
findings.currentExpectation: Coverage includes direct className strings, cn/cva strings, template interpolation and one dynamic member expression, but not common constant, array, clsx or style-object indirection.
findings.requiredExpectation: Resolvable indirection must be scanned. Unresolvable governed expressions must produce an explicit unsupported finding rather than return clean.

findings.requirement: D2 hard floor and D3 single directed token graph
findings.currentExpectation: Registered `var(--type-*)` references are treated as clean while the test policy leaves resolvedTokens empty; no test proves a registered token cannot resolve below 12px or be shadowed locally.
findings.requiredExpectation: A registered type token resolving below 12px must be rejected by this scanner or by a specifically asserted token-graph gate. Local declarations must not shadow canonical registered type tokens with unsafe values.

findings.requirement: D1/D2 prove the 12px minimum across the 12–20px root range and narrow reflow; unsupported governed syntax fails closed
findings.currentExpectation: The suite covers px, rem, vw, em, vh and a few calc/min/max/clamp shapes, but leaves several relative units, zero/negative values, nested math and Tailwind @apply untested.
findings.requiredExpectation: Each governed unit or function must be safely evaluated at the policy boundaries or produce an unsupported finding; none may silently return clean.
